findings.location: HTML poem, sentence beginning “Han trengte noen svar”
findings.source_quote: He needed some answers, to fix how things were.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the comma after «svar»: «Han trengte noen svar for å rette opp tingene.»
findings.translation_quote: Han trengte noen svar, for å rette opp tingene.

findings.location: HTML poem, sentence beginning “Han visste uten tvil”
findings.source_quote: He knew with no doubt that he was made whole.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a more idiomatic Norwegian rendering, such as «Han visste uten tvil at han var blitt hel igjen.»
findings.translation_quote: Han visste uten tvil at han var blitt gjort hel.
